subject: Partner Engage Playhouse: SI onboarding proposal
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@aperture.solutions>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah@aperture.solutions>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Partner Engage Playhouse: SI onboarding proposal

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for taking time at the Alliances meetup last week — enjoyed the conversation about lightweight sandboxes and partner-first onboarding. Aperture has been sketching a hands-on "Playhouse" format for consulting partners: a focused, 2-week immersion that combines a pre-built sandbox, live labs, and a short certification for SI engineers.

Attached is our first draft of the curriculum (playhouse-curriculum-v0.3.pdf). High level asks from our side: a short Redwood demo for the lab environment, a tokenized sandbox instance we can load sample customers into, and a 90-minute technical Q&A during week 1.

Proposed timeline: run the first cohort in early January. Before we lock dates we wanted to run this by your enablement team and sketch a mutual action plan.

Key questions:
- Who at Redwood should be the primary enablement contact?
- Can you provision a sandbox with two models and a sample dataset (PII-free) we can use for exercises?
- Any guardrails we should be aware of around private deployments?

If this is interesting, can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to map tasks and owners? I can be flexible Tue/Wed afternoon PST.

Thanks,
Daniel Park
Partnerships, Aperture Solutions
attachments: playhouse-curriculum-v0.3.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@aperture.solutions>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner Engage Playhouse: SI onboarding proposal

Daniel —

Appreciate the write-up and the curriculum draft. This is very much aligned with the kind of partner ramp we want to scale. Quick answers up front: Naomi (partner enablement) should be the primary contact for curriculum and certification logistics; Jonas (alliances) will help with commercial alignment and co-marketing. I'll be the technical liaison for the first run.

We can provide a tokenized sandbox environment scoped for an SI cohort. Typical approach: two model variants (a base open model and a lower-latency quantized variant), a synthetic sample dataset, and a preset RBAC role for instructors. We do need a mutual action plan to capture tasks, owners, and export risks — I attached a template (mutual-action-plan-aperture.xlsx) with my initial fills.

Suggested next steps:
- 30-minute kickoff with Naomi + Jonas + me to confirm timeline and guardrails
- Aperture to confirm cohort size and target skills (ops, prompt engineering, deployment)
- Redwood to provision sandbox and draft lab exercises (we can reuse a couple internal labs to shorten time)

I can do Tue 23rd 10:00-10:30am PST or Wed 24th 2pm PST. Which works better?

Regards,
Irene Choi
Sr. Alliances Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | irene_choi@redwoodinference.com
attachments: mutual-action-plan-aperture.xlsx

From: Daniel Park <daniel@aperture.solutions>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Li <sarah@aperture.solutions>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner Engage Playhouse: SI onboarding proposal

Irene — thanks. Tue 23rd 10:00am PST works for our team; I'll calendar it and include a short agenda.

Draft agenda (attached as kickoff-agenda.docx):
- 10m: Introductions + outcomes
- 10m: Sandbox topology + RBAC model (Redwood)
- 15m: Curriculum overview (Aperture)
- 10m: Mutual action plan / owners
- 5m: Next steps & calendar

Cohort target: 8 engineers (mix of SI pre-sales and implementation). Primary goals: ability to deploy Redwood in a demo sandbox, run a simple RL loop with ingestion and reranking, and validate model selection/quantization tradeoffs.

Two quick notes on constraints:
1) For the first pilot we prefer a hosted sandbox rather than a private on-prem stack — quicker to stand up.
2) We'll need a short NDA addendum for the shared lab artifacts (we'll send a draft).

See you on Tue.

—Daniel
Partnerships, Aperture Solutions
attachments: kickoff-agenda.docx

To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Partner Engage Playhouse: SI onboarding proposal

Team —

Following our kickoff and the Aperture thread, I'm locking in enablement resources for the Playhouse pilot. Action items I'm assigning:

- Ben Carter: lead on lab build and instructor guide (owner for lab exercises and runbooks).
- Jonas Weber: coordinate co-marketing collateral and logistics for cohort sign-up.
- Irene: technical liaison for sandbox topology and RBAC approvals.
- Myself: certification criteria and scoring rubric; I'll pair with Ben on the first pilot session.

We will provision a hosted sandbox (two model variants, 8 seats) the week before the cohort start date and provide an instructor RBAC token. Security note: the sandbox will use synthetic datasets only; no customer PII. Ops will enable a short log export to a secured Drive link for audit during the pilot.

Ben — I dropped a checklist into the shared Playhouse folder and added a stub for the instructor guide. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PlayhouseSandbox

I'll draft an internal runbook for escalation (rate limits, fallback model) and share by Tuesday.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Partner Enablement Manager, Redwood Inference
